name: Alicetia Wallenberg Kezouji
original_name: アリスティア・ヴァレンベリ・華蔵寺
source:
Alicetia Wallenberg Kezouji doesn't quite fit in, not even with the cats she feeds. She does tend to mutter and glare when she talks, which has earned her the nickname Ms. Evil One. She holds Gekka's presidency by her pedigree and unintentional terror.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/shiravune/status/1421221240920952832]Shiravune[/url]]

Class: 2-D
Hobbies: Making sweets

Gekka-kai's student council president.
